environment.validation_scope: single CUDA ordinal; cross-device checks archived in launchfix audit

config.comparison: same matched six-permutation protocol; cached-loop vs prepared fused launcher, Dense128 control; batch1 focus
config.primary_scope: OCBE + student pure forward; exclude teacher and scoring
config.secondary_scope: pack/projection, fuse MLP, OCBE, subnet, subnet+score, common normalization/student; batch1 only
config.weight_source: All seven final epoch15 raw Qs restored from archived JSON; full original OCBE/student checkpoints were not saved. Other weights use deterministic seed42 architecture initialization. No new AUC claim.
config.input: GPU-resident synthetic teacher-shaped slices [B,261,768][:,5:] for each of twelve taps
config.only_change: same exact projection and prepared launcher; only measurement context setup and CPU affinity differ
cache_invalidation: standard in-place raw parameter version update
reference_controls: cached arbitrary learnable Q with original group loops
config.scope_note: one implementation optimization audit with two existing controls; no training architecture or Q/loss variants
config.profiling: separate child process after all batch1 timing; no profiler startup in measurement process

kernel.arithmetic: explicit libdevice mul_rn / add_rn in original left-associative order; reject any FP32 FMA in generated PTX

config.reason_for_followup: Absolute FPS drift including the Dense128 control: single-CUDA context plus fixed local CPU affinity for reproducible paired comparison
